question.text: Manganese <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mi>VI</mi></mfenced></math> has ability to disproportionate in acidic solution. The difference in oxidation states of two ions it forms in acidic solution is

solution.text:
In acidic solution Mn(VI) become unstable relative to Mn(VII) and Mn(IV)

3MnO42-+4H+→2MnO4-+MnO2+2H2O
So difference in oxidation state of product ions of Mn is = 3
